# Design with Color Cubes

> Free files to 3D print Color Cubes, the 1930s pattern toy, for sets of 16 to 100 cubes, a box designer for the lid and tray, and an online designer for laying out and sharing patterns. A free project by Isaac Lloyd; nothing is for sale.

Full notes for AI agents, including how to write a tray code and link to a design: https://designwithcolorcubes.org/agents.md

## Pages

- [Home](https://designwithcolorcubes.org/): Color Cubes, the Pattern Toy: print a set and the toy's history
- [Print a set](https://designwithcolorcubes.org/#print): the exact files for your set size and print bed
- [Box designer](https://designwithcolorcubes.org/box/): a lid and tray for any size, with your own designs and words
- [Designer](https://designwithcolorcubes.org/designer/): lay out a tray, see it in 3D, print it, share it
- [Patterns](https://designwithcolorcubes.org/patterns/): 841 ready-made designs
- [History](https://designwithcolorcubes.org/history/): where the toy came from and the Kohs Block Design Test, with sources ([as Markdown](https://designwithcolorcubes.org/history/color-cubes-history.md))
- [Files](https://designwithcolorcubes.org/downloads/): every download on its own, with Download all per section
- [Pattern data](https://designwithcolorcubes.org/data/patterns.json): every design as a tray code
- [Print file list](https://designwithcolorcubes.org/data/files.json): every print file with its size
- [Download list](https://designwithcolorcubes.org/data/downloads.json): every file on the Files page
